reoccurrence_verification.fills_positions_hash_difference_explaine: Expected and documented by the source blueprint (README.md: 'Generated identities are not claimed to repeat'); only generated identity fields differ, verified by the economic-only hash matching exactly.
reoccurrence_verification.correction: A prior draft of this receipt computed economic_repeat_sha256 by hashing reports.json's fields directly, which is economically equivalent but not byte-identical to the oracle's CSV-string-based encoding, so it produced a different hash (338d9548...,fe8baf74...) than the recorded oracle even though the underlying results matched. Recomputing from the CSVs via csv.DictReader, matching receipt.json's documented economic_hash_encoding, reproduces the oracle hashes exactly; this receipt now records that corrected hash.
